$comment: Pinned sources for scripts/rmhmusic/build-instruments.ts. Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before use. keyCenter is the SOUNDING MIDI note the build must measure (YIN) within pitchToleranceSemitones; tuneCents, where given, is the upstream tuning table (Salamander Retuned) and is otherwise measured.
